svg.title: Komorebi-Prism: what one gives it, the card drawing alone
svg.text: the card draws it by itself
the camera and one command a frame
pulls: a core asks X280 1 for a thread
every core inside a tile thread
between two frames, every core: an apply
the core that takes a tile runs, in order:

svg.text: ms: one Blackhole P150A, 1,920 x 1,080, the median frame on the card at each scene's view. Standing: the camera still, the lists kept, the tile pull alone;
moving: the lists made again each frame. gi less push: the stage-wise frame less its push to the host. Pictures: gi_threads in the viewer at 1,920 x 1,080;
Italian Flat's at 1,280 x 720 at the camera of the comparison with Cycles, which reads the same glTF file (docs/performance/gltf_truth.md).
Curved surfaces are drawn with flat triangles (a glTF file's vertex normals are not carried yet), visible on Sponza's banners.
Scenes: Crytek Sponza (Frank Meinl, Crytek; CC BY 3.0); Amazon Lumberyard Bistro (ORCA; CC BY 4.0); Breakfast Room (Wig42; CC BY 3.0);
Italian Flat (Flavio Della Tommasa, malapixel.com; CC BY).
